annotations.title: Restart a server to apply changed settings

description: Restarts only the Minecraft program on an online server so changed settings apply; players drop for a few seconds while it reloads content from Modrinth, CurseForge or their download links. Use it when the server reports a restart is required; for a size change use restartServer. If a pending change needs a full reboot (size, or a restore queued with restoreBackup) it reboots the machine instead. Fails unless online (use startServer).

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
